CORRECTION (2026-07-31, A0 root-cause pass, per output/NODATA-ROOT-CAUSE-ANALYSIS-2026-07-31.md): originally classified doc_presence because the question itself is presence-framed ('Are the 4 ... data points provided in file'), but the actual defect is checking whether the CIP data points appear consistently across every document in the file that carries them -- no single named document decides this. Reclassified to cross_doc_consistency after individual hand review; the presence-framed question text is a mismatch with what the defect option actually tests.
